title: quickly/badly/suddenly etc. (adverbs)
summary: Наречия отвечают на вопрос «как?»: прилагательное + -ly (quickly), особые слова well, hard, fast, late, early.
ru:
## Наречие: как?
**Прилагательное** описывает существительное (*a quick train*). **Наречие** описывает действие: **как** что-то происходит (*the train stopped quickly*). Обычно оно образуется так: **прилагательное + -ly**.
| прилагательное | наречие |
|---|---|
| quick | quick**ly** |
| bad | bad**ly** |
| sudden | sudden**ly** |
| careful | careful**ly** |
| quiet | quiet**ly** |
Правописание: **-y → -ily**: *easy → easily, heavy → heavily*.
> The train stopped **suddenly**. — Поезд внезапно остановился.
> I opened the door **slowly**. — Я медленно открыла дверь.
> Please listen **carefully**. — Пожалуйста, слушайте внимательно.

## Прилагательное или наречие?
- **прилагательное** — к существительному / после be, look, feel: *Sue is **quiet**. Be **careful**!*
- **наречие** — к глаголу: *Sue speaks **quietly**. Listen **carefully**.*
> It was a **bad** game. — Our team played **badly**.
> I feel **nervous**. — I waited **nervously**.

## hard, fast, late, early
Эти слова одинаковы и как прилагательное, и как наречие:
> Sue's job is **hard**. → Sue works **hard**. (не ~~hardly~~)
> Ben is a **fast** runner. → Ben can run **fast**.
> The bus was **late**. → I went to bed **late**.
**hardly** — это «едва ли», совсем другое слово!

## good → well
> Your English is **good**. — Your English is **very good**.
> You speak English **very well**. (не ~~very good~~)
> Our team played **well**.
**well** — ещё и прилагательное («здоровый»): *How are you? — I'm very **well**, thank you.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Sue speaks very quiet.~~ → Sue speaks very **quietly**.
- ~~Listen careful.~~ → Listen **carefully**.
- ~~He plays football good.~~ → He plays football **well**.
- ~~She works hardly.~~ → She works **hard**.
en:
## Adverbs: how?
An **adjective** describes a noun (*a quick train*). An **adverb** describes a verb: **how** something happens (*the train stopped quickly*). Most adverbs are **adjective + -ly**.
| adjective | adverb |
|---|---|
| quick | quick**ly** |
| bad | bad**ly** |
| sudden | sudden**ly** |
| careful | careful**ly** |
Spelling: **-y → -ily**: *easy → easily, heavy → heavily*.
> The train stopped **suddenly**. · I opened the door **slowly**. · Please listen **carefully**.

## Adjective or adverb?
- adjective: with a noun or after be / look / feel: *Sue is **quiet**. Be **careful**!*
- adverb: with a verb: *Sue speaks **quietly**. Listen **carefully**.*
> It was a **bad** game. — Our team played **badly**.

## hard, fast, late, early
They are the same as adjectives and adverbs:
> Sue's job is **hard**. → Sue works **hard**. (not ~~hardly~~)
> Ben is a **fast** runner. → Ben can run **fast**.
> The bus was **late**. → I went to bed **late**.

## good → well
> Your English is **good**. → You speak English **well**. (not ~~very good~~)
**well** is also an adjective (= healthy): *I'm very **well**, thank you.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~Sue speaks very quiet.~~ → Sue speaks very **quietly**.
- ~~He plays football good.~~ → He plays football **well**.
- ~~She works hardly.~~ → She works **hard**.
structure:
## Образование наречий
| правило | прилагательное → наречие |
|---|---|
| + -ly | slow → slowly, quiet → quietly |
| -y → -ily | easy → easily, angry → angrily, heavy → heavily |
| особые | good → **well** |
| то же слово | hard, fast, late, early |

## Формулы
> подлежащее + глагол + **наречие**: *She sings beautifully.*
> **be / look / feel** + прилагательное: *She is quiet.*
> **very** + наречие: *very slowly, very well*

## Место наречия
> *He drives fast.* · *She spoke quietly.* · *They played badly.*
> Наречие способа обычно стоит **после глагола** или после дополнения: *She opened the door slowly.*

exercises.instruction: Образуйте наречие от слова в скобках.

exercises.title: Прилагательное или наречие?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово из скобок в нужной форме — прилагательное или наречие.

items.q: I went to bed ___ last night.

answers: We came into the room quietly.
We went into the room quietly.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя наречия. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I speak English slowly, but I understand well.
I study hard and work carefully.
I walk quickly when I'm late.
